description: Land Acquisition - Medapitiya, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Sitinamaluwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1822/23 of 08.08.2013
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and acquisition procedures for public purposes.
